$schema: Datum family app summary, read by the Datum hub site (github.com/Edgar-Mendonca/Datum) and by Help › Roadmap in the app.
name: Datum Atlas
tagline: Choose the right material: property charts, selection and referenced data, in one app for Windows.
for: Design and materials engineers, and students.
highlights: 100 materials from every family. Every value names its source, and values are being checked against published datasheets one by one, starting with the metals.
Property charts of any two properties, with family envelopes, zoom, pan and guide lines, and bar charts of one property.
22 design goals that set the axes, the selection line and the limits in one pick, and explain why.
Selection by limits, index lines, boxes and families; results ranked, with the reason every other material fails.
SI or imperial units everywhere; derived properties such as specific stiffness, cost per volume and thermal diffusivity.
Add your own materials; print charts, datasheets and results, export charts as SVG or PNG, or copy them as a picture.

roadmap.title: Lines and charts
items: Results to a spreadsheet; keyboard control.
More values checked against published datasheets (the rest of the metals, then polymers).

roadmap.title: Indices
items: An index builder with about 40 indices.

roadmap.title: Your own data
items: Several databases; CSV and spreadsheet import with column mapping.
Label placement, style presets, polygon selection.

roadmap.title: Eco audit
items: Energy and CO₂ across a product's life.

roadmap.title: Stable
items: About 1,000 materials, a user guide and a signed installer.
